identity-substitution.description: Substitute signer identity for the immediate predecessor at an authorization boundary.
Change the participant identity in an MPC session view.
Change the participant subset in an MPC session view.
Change the message bound to an MPC session view.
Change the tweak bound to an MPC session view.

access-macro-removal.description: Remove the exact one-yocto deposit guard.

late-reservation.description: Move the debit or reservation after asynchronous promise dispatch.
Remove or change the beneficiary binding in a mutating resume record.
Remove or change the operation-mode binding in a mutating resume record.
Remove or change the filter binding in a mutating resume record.

promise-result-semantics.description: Ignore the promise result before settlement.
Invert the success/failure interpretation of a promise result.
Decode a promise result using an incompatible value or representation.

callback-gas.description: Reduce reserved callback gas below the amount needed by the tested path.

refund-cap.description: Remove the resolver or refund cap.

storage-accounting.description: Reuse a persistent collection prefix for a different collection.
Remove a storage charge for newly occupied state.
Remove storage cleanup or its associated accounting.

terminal-promise.description: Remove the returned terminal Promise from an asynchronous chain.

arithmetic-rounding.description: Replace checked arithmetic with an unchecked operation.
Change the rounding direction at a value conversion or distribution boundary.

migration-layout.description: Change migration logic so it no longer preserves the old-state interpretation.

key-capability.description: Substitute a key with different capabilities.
Change the assumed key or account balance backing an operation.
Change the nonce-lane assumption used for authorization or replay protection.

yield-resume-binding.description: Remove expiry enforcement on a resumed operation.
Remove the terminal-state or one-time-resume binding.

refund-principal.description: Send the refund to the beneficiary instead of the actual payer or operation owner.
Send the refund to the relayer instead of the actual payer or operation owner.

transfer-call-polarity.description: Invert receiver unused-amount and caller spent-amount interpretations.

route-finality.description: Weaken the permitted event emitter check.
Weaken the source or destination chain binding.

serializer-mismatch.description: Mismatch the schema or serializer across a receipt boundary.
Mismatch the schema or serializer across a relayer boundary.
Mismatch the schema or serializer across an external-chain boundary.

deployed-code-identity.description: Accept a deployed or global-contract code identity without verification.
Accept a deployed or global-contract version change without verification.
